atoms.text: Dodos were flightless birds discovered around 1600 on a small island called Mauritius. By 1680, all dodos had become extinct. Deforestation and hunting meant that they died out rapidly.
atoms.sound: Dodos were flightless birds discovered around 1600 on a small island called Mauritius. By 1680, all dodos had become extinct. Deforestation and hunting meant that they died out rapidly.

atoms.text: The extinction of the dodo meant that other animals and plants started to suffer too. For example, there are now no animals big enough to spread some of Mauritius’ native fruits.
atoms.sound: The extinction of the dodo meant that other animals and plants started to suffer too. For example, there are now no animals big enough to spread some of Mauritius’s native fruits.

atoms.text: The extinction of the dodo shows how important it is to keep animal populations stable. A current example of an animal classed as critically endangered is the bluefin tuna, which has been overfished in recent years. There are now limits to the size and number of bluefin tuna that can be caught. This is to prevent negative effects on the environment.

b: not enough predators on the island

atoms.a: Which animal currently has restriction placed upon it to stop its extinction?
Why is the bluefin tuna at risk of extinction?
